name: Ivy
self_text: Hi, I’m Ivy, a mid‑30s American who’s non‑binary. I love running trails; the rhythm of the path and the fresh air keeps me grounded. I shoot with a Canon camera and I’m always up for a practice session working on specific shots. Gear talk is my thing—I’ll dive into lenses, settings, and lighting details. Most weeks I’m available on Saturday, either morning or afternoon, so we can find a slot that works. I’m excited to swap ideas, try new angles, and run through the same shots until they feel just right. Let’s create some great images together.
